entries.name: Quellenhof Gourmet-Stube 1897
entries.description: Michelin 1 star (2026 newcomer). Family-run hotel restaurant in Val Passiria/Passeier Valley. Chef Michael Mayr. Alpine ingredients.

entries.name: Ristorante Porcino
entries.address: Via Runch 8, 39030 San Cassiano, Alta Badia, Südtirol, Italy
entries.description: Michelin 1 star (2026 newcomer). Chef Marco Verginer. 'Mountain cottage' style in the Dolomites of Alta Badia.

entries.name: Atelier Moessmer
entries.description: Led by 3-Michelin and Green-starred chef Norbert Niederkofler. Extraordinary culinary destination. Bold, boundary-pushing alpine cuisine.

entries.name: Gelateria Cristallino
entries.description: Artisan gelato in the heart of Brunico. Popular stop near the Dolomites.

entries.name: Caffè Moessmer
entries.description: Café and gelato bar attached to the Moessmer hotel. Part of the Niederkofler hospitality group.
